home.h1: I'm Arnold Kengne, a software & DevOps engineer based in Douala, Cameroon.
bio: I design and build modern software architectures (microservices, Clean Architecture, hexagonal architecture) as well as large-scale web and mobile applications, from modeling to production.
Rigorous, results-driven and highly adaptable, I enjoy tackling complex technical challenges — feel free to reach out and say hello!
milestones: In 2026, I earned the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification.
In December 2025, I joined Sorawel as a software engineer to integrate and deploy the Odoo ERP.
Between 2023 and 2024, I built NOE, the mobile app for generating reports for KES Africa.
In 2023, I earned my engineering degree (design track) in computer engineering from ENSPD.
home.s1Text: When I'm not coding, you'll find me playing sports, reading — both technical and general literature — or playing video games. I also love traveling and listening to music.
home.s2Text: I was a web development trainer at PADESCE-WESCO in Douala. I taught the full software development cycle, from design to production, through hands-on workshops on HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and PHP.

qtransit.pitch: SaaS ERP for intercity bus companies: operations, ticketing, treasury and reporting in a single multi-company platform.
about: QTransit centralizes the management of an intercity bus company: agencies, buses, drivers, routes and trips, all the way to ticket sales and cash register tracking.
The platform is built as SaaS: each company gets its own space with isolated data. It relies on a web admin portal, an API and a mobile app for passengers.
features: Secure authentication with refresh tokens, roles and permissions.
Operations management: agencies, buses, drivers, routes and trips.
Ticketing with an interactive seat map and automatic seat assignment.
Treasury: cash registers are credited automatically on counter sales.
Protection against concurrent sales on the same trip or cash register.

armurerie-belibi.pitch: Online showcase for a Cameroonian armory: products and services, four branches and direct contact via WhatsApp, with smooth anchor navigation on a single page.
about: The official showcase website of Armurerie BELIBI, a Cameroonian company specialized in hunting, defense and security equipment. It presents the company, its catalog, its branches and how to reach it.

For this first version, everything fits on a single page: no separate pages for products, services or branches. Visitors move from one section to the next through anchor navigation. There is no online purchase: requests go through direct contact, mainly WhatsApp or phone.
features: One-page site with anchor navigation to five sections.
Compact, elegant header with a discreet, visible action button.
Sticky header that never hides section titles during anchor navigation.
Accessible mobile menu with working open and close.
Products and services: hunting, defense, self-defense, repair workshop, accessories and security equipment, law enforcement.
Four branches shown with their opening hours: Yaoundé (head office), Douala, Ambam and Ebolowa.
Direct contact via WhatsApp or phone.
Institutional, reassuring tone, with a reminder of the regulatory framework.
